basic_info.description: Classic Sunset center patio home with timeless character and modern updates. This 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence features hardwood floors throughout and an elegant formal living room with a corner gas fireplace and elegant paned French-style casement windows that open to a Juliette balcony. The recently remodeled, generously sized kitchen pairs with the dining room to form the heart of the home, while two spacious bedrooms and a updated bathroom complete the main level.    The lower level includes a third bedroom, second updated bath, and a large family room that opens directly to a large landscaped yard, perfect for indoor-outdoor living. A generous garage offers abundant storage and laundry.    Enjoy nearby shops, markets, and cafes along Noriega & Judah, with Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, and Sunset Rec Center just minutes away. Easy access to the N-Judah, 19th Avenue, and Sunset Boulevard makes commuting simple.  An ideal mix of charm, space, and location, this home is ready to welcome its next chapter.
